text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I dropped by the dance studio to 
watch Daiichi Ruby's practice—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And why ballroom dance, of all things? We 
were scheduled for live dance practice...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Ruby-senpai's Trainer! Hello! 
Ruby-senpai and I are hanging out right 
now!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"...That was not my intention at all. 
However, due to various circumstances—"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*... Ugh... What else am I 
supposed to do...?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me.
It is almost time for the shift 
change. Please prepare to leave the room—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: !!! The savior has arriiiived!!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
... I'm not quite sure I understand what 
you're saying.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ruby-senpai, you're great at ballroom 
dancing,
aren't you?! I saw you dancing so 
gracefully at the soirée before!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
El... wants to master it, no matter what! 
So I can make a name for myself on the 
world stage, too.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
If only to avoid remedial dance
lessons, I 
must!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
It will serve as a warm-up, too! Right? I 
will not budge from here until you say 
yes, no!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
“—Therefore,
I am simply lending a hand so 
that I may quickly get to my own lessons.”

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Still... this really is so hard,
desu! The 
tempo and movements are just way too 
different from salsa~~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I understand just how difficult ballroom 
dancing is. Wanting to help Daiichi Ruby 
secure enough practice time, I thought to 
offer some advice—
choice_data_list: I guess practice really does make ...
Let me teach you the proper mindse...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, is that all, desu? Don't you have 
something more, like, sharp and decisive 
to advise?
choice_data_list: Let's teach them the right mindset...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
If a professional instructor says so, we 
should follow obediently―― Now, let's 
start the music.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Move your legs a bit more boldly.
Match my 
lead... yes, just like that.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Alright, so next is this... Ooh~! I'm 
really starting to get the hang of it!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
1, 2, 3... 1, 2, 3... ...Alright! It's 
right here~♪

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu! Now that I've mastered it,
El will 
take the lead this time~!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
If you have mastered it,
please vacate the 
room immediately. We are falling behind 
schedule.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Que!? No way!
And just when it was getting 
fun~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that,
Daiichi Ruby practiced dancing 
alone... Perhaps as a result of her 
experience teaching others, her dancing 
improved even further.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Mindset, you say, desu?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"...If you, a professional instructor,
say 
so, then let us do just that. ——Now then, 
cue the music."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Lift your head. If you wish to achieve 
something, you must always carry yourself 
with dignity. ...What is it that you wish 
to achieve?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
E-El is...
El is going to be the strongest 
in the world!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
In that case, act fittingly. With 
powerful, flawless, and fearless steps.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Right on it, Ruby-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daiichi Ruby provided thorough 
instruction... and perhaps as a result of 
that experience, her own dancing improved 
even further.
